appearances.summary: Open WebUI v0.13.0 lets a self-hosted model open apps on a real desktop, test its work in a browser, and leave edits in Git for review. A lead model can hand research, coding and review to sub-agents on other models, with optional approval on each tool call.

appearances.title: Open WebUI 0.13.0 gives the model a computer
appearances.summary: Open WebUI 0.13.0 can attach a self-hosted model to a real desktop through Open Terminal, so it opens apps, checks its work in a browser, and leaves edits in a Git panel you can diff, commit, and push. The release also adds optional sub-agents, tool-call approvals, and inline comments, plus security fixes and a database migration.
